data.title: Banca Sistema Calls Extraordinary Meeting on Merger and €100 Million Capital Plan
data.description:
Banca Sistema S.p.A. ( (IT:BST) ) just unveiled an update.

Banca Sistema S.p.A. has convened an extraordinary shareholders’ meeting for 12 October 2026 in Milan to vote on the planned merger by incorporation of Banca CF+ S.p.A. into Banca Sistema. The meeting will also consider related amendments to the Articles of Association, including a capital increase connected to the merger.

Shareholders are further asked to approve changes to Article 5 of the Articles of Association, granting the Board of Directors the authority to raise share capital by up to €100 million over five years, with or without pre-emptive rights, once the merger is completed. Detailed rules for meeting participation, record date, and proxy voting, including the appointment of Monte Titoli as designated shareholders’ representative, outline a structured process aimed at enabling broad investor involvement in these key strategic decisions.

data.title: Gran Tierra Seeks Noteholder Consent to Amend 2031 Secured Notes Ahead of Asset Sale
data.description:

Gran Tierra Energy Inc. has launched a consent solicitation for holders of its 9.750% Senior Secured Amortizing Notes due 2031 to approve amendments to the existing indenture. The company is offering a consent fee of US$2.50 per US$1,000 in principal to noteholders who agree by the September 22, 2026 deadline, with effectiveness contingent on achieving majority approval and closing a previously announced asset sale.

data.description:

IntegraGen SA, a French genomics company focused on cancer and rare genetic diseases, provides advanced DNA sequencing and genomic data interpretation services to academic and private labs. Listed on Euronext Growth Paris, it operates one of France’s largest NGS laboratories and plays a significant role in supporting precision medicine for research institutes and healthcare stakeholders.

IntegraGen announced it has received two takeover offers from Health In Code and ABL Diagnostics as part of a court‑ordered restructuring process initiated in June 2026. data.title: Draganfly Wins Five-Year Contract to Supply Tactical ISR Drones to Canadian Armed Forces
data.description:

Under the agreement, Canada may order up to 4,900 additional systems with options for further training and sustainment, reinforcing Draganfly’s role in the country’s Defence Drone Initiative and expanding its position within Canada’s domestic defence and uncrewed systems ecosystem.

This contract follows Draganfly’s recent acceptance as a qualified supplier across all categories of Canada’s Defence Drone Initiative Marketplace, underscoring the firm’s strategic alignment with Ottawa’s push to strengthen sovereign defence capabilities and the domestic industrial base. data.title: Pharming wins FDA nod to extend Joenja use to younger APDS children
data.description:
Pharming Group ( (NL:PHARM) ) has provided an announcement.

Pharming has secured U.S. FDA approval for new 40 mg and 50 mg twice-daily doses of Joenja (leniolisib) to treat children aged 4 to 11 years who weigh at least 27 kg and have APDS, a rare primary immunodeficiency. This makes Joenja the first FDA-approved therapy for APDS in this younger pediatric group, with the new doses expected to reach patients through Pharming’s specialty distribution network in October.

The expanded indication builds on Joenja’s existing approval for patients 12 and older and is backed by Phase III data showing improvements in key disease markers with a safety profile consistent with earlier use. The move strengthens Pharming’s position in the rare disease space, offers earlier intervention for APDS to potentially prevent irreversible complications, and underscores ongoing efforts to broaden access through additional regulatory filings for lighter pediatric patients.

Pharming Group N.V. is a global biotechnology company headquartered in Leiden, the Netherlands, with operations in the U.S. and Europe. The company develops and commercializes innovative medicines targeting rare immune and genetic diseases, focusing on unmet medical needs in highly specialized patient populations.

Its portfolio includes Joenja (leniolisib), an oral small-molecule PI3Kδ inhibitor that is the first and only approved treatment for activated phosphoinositide 3-kinase delta syndrome (APDS) across multiple major markets.
